works.title: Paper bags for a fashion store

about.text: A Dammam print house that cares about what makes the difference: the material, the finish, true colour and delivery on time.

points.title: Design and print under one roof
points.text: We prepare the design, print and pack in one place.

points.title: Luxury finishes
points.text: Gold and silver foil, embossing, lamination and die-cutting.

points.title: A clear price and a date we keep
points.text: We fix the price and date before we start, and keep to them.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.text: The product, quantity and size, and your design file if you have one.

steps.title: We review and confirm
steps.text: We agree the material and price, and you see a proof first.

steps.title: We print and deliver
steps.text: We print once you approve, and deliver on the agreed date.
